# Enemy Database

All 30 enemy types. Every entry states why it exists as a gameplay problem — the brief required that no enemy be decorative.

## The Chungie gear ladder

The core enemy. 'Chungie' is community slang for an under-geared player; here the tiers are Minecraft gear tiers. When a layer's health is depleted the gear visibly breaks off and the unit keeps running in whatever is underneath, carrying overflow damage down with it. This is the game's original take on layered enemies — it is built on gear progression, not on colour.

## Special enemies


### Elytra Glider

Rocket-boosted elytra flight over the walls. Ground traps and melee cannot touch it.

**Why it exists:** Forces anti-air / ranged coverage.

## Damage and armor

```
effective = raw × (1 − armor_pct × (1 − armor_pen))
effective = max(effective, raw × 0.10)      # armor can never fully negate a hit
```

Damage types then modify the result against shields and structures:

| Type | vs shield | vs structure | Ignores armor |
|---|---|---|---|
| melee | ×1.00 | ×0.70 | no |
| ranged | ×0.65 | ×0.40 | no |
| explosive | ×1.30 | ×1.50 | no |
| magic | ×1.00 | ×0.50 | no |
| true | ×1.00 | ×1.00 | yes |
